title: Create a 10-second cinematic video using the reference image as visual…
content:
Create a 10-second cinematic video using the reference image as visual inspiration. The scene should begin with a plain, dark, textured emerald-black surface filling the entire frame, with no visible face at first. The background should feel smooth, minimal, mysterious, and slightly organic, as if something is hidden beneath it.
From second 0 to second 2, keep the frame nearly still and empty, with only subtle ambient motion in the texture and a slow, gentle camera push forward. The mood should feel quiet, introspective, and suspenseful.
From second 2 onward, the woman’s face gradually emerges out of the darkness, as if forming from within the surface itself. First the eyes become faintly visible, then the nose and lips softly appear, until the face becomes clear enough to hold a direct, calm, penetrating gaze toward the viewer. Her appearance should feel surreal and elegant, not abrupt or scary. Keep the movements extremely subtle: one soft blink, slight breath, and delicate facial stillness.
As the face becomes visible, she speaks slowly and clearly in a soft, reflective female voice:
“You do not need more time. You need fewer things pretending to deserve your attention.”
Her lips must synchronize naturally with the full sentence. Her expression should remain composed, wise, and quietly intense. The line should feel philosophical, insightful, and practical.
After she finishes speaking, let the face gradually dissolve back into the same dark textured surface, with the features fading away until only the plain emerald-black background remains, echoing the beginning. The final moment should feel calm, haunting, and complete.
Audio: soft close-mic female voice, subtle breath texture, minimal atmospheric ambience, no music, no dramatic sound effects.
Visual style: surreal cinematic realism, minimalist, photorealistic, moody, philosophical, deep emerald and charcoal tones, soft film grain, refined lighting, slow hypnotic pacing.
Technical direction: single continuous shot, no cuts, exactly 10 seconds, no subtitles, no on-screen text.

es.content:
Crea un video cinematográfico de 10 segundos usando la imagen de referencia como inspiración visual. La escena debe comenzar con una superficie lisa, oscura y texturizada de color verde esmeralda-negro que llena todo el encuadre, sin que se vea ningún rostro al principio. El fondo debe sentirse suave, minimalista, misterioso y ligeramente orgánico, como si algo estuviera oculto debajo.
Del segundo 0 al segundo 2, mantén el encuadre casi inmóvil y vacío, con solo un movimiento ambiental sutil en la textura y un lento y suave avance de cámara hacia delante. El ambiente debe sentirse silencioso, introspectivo y lleno de suspense.
A partir del segundo 2, el rostro de la mujer emerge gradualmente de la oscuridad, como si se formara desde el interior de la propia superficie. Primero los ojos se vuelven apenas visibles, luego la nariz y los labios aparecen suavemente, hasta que el rostro queda lo bastante claro como para sostener una mirada directa, serena y penetrante hacia el espectador. Su apariencia debe sentirse surrealista y elegante, no brusca ni aterradora. Mantén los movimientos extremadamente sutiles: un parpadeo suave, una ligera respiración y una delicada quietud facial.
A medida que el rostro se vuelve visible, ella habla despacio y con claridad con una voz femenina suave y reflexiva:
“You do not need more time. You need fewer things pretending to deserve your attention.”
Sus labios deben sincronizarse de forma natural con la frase completa. Su expresión debe permanecer compuesta, sabia y silenciosamente intensa. La línea debe sentirse filosófica, perspicaz y práctica.
Después de que termine de hablar, deja que el rostro se disuelva gradualmente de nuevo en la misma superficie oscura y texturizada, con los rasgos desvaneciéndose hasta que solo quede el fondo liso verde esmeralda-negro, en eco con el comienzo. El momento final debe sentirse calmado, inquietante y completo.
Audio: voz femenina suave grabada de cerca con micrófono, textura sutil de respiración, ambiente atmosférico mínimo, sin música, sin efectos de sonido dramáticos.
Estilo visual: realismo cinematográfico surrealista, minimalista, fotorrealista, melancólico, filosófico, tonos verde esmeralda profundo y carbón, grano de película suave, iluminación refinada, ritmo lento e hipnótico.
Dirección técnica: una sola toma continua, sin cortes, exactamente 10 segundos, sin subtítulos, sin texto en pantalla.

fr.content:
Créez une vidéo cinématographique de 10 secondes en utilisant l’image de référence comme inspiration visuelle. La scène doit commencer par une surface simple, sombre, texturée, vert émeraude-noir, occupant tout le cadre, sans visage visible au départ. L’arrière-plan doit paraître lisse, minimaliste, mystérieux et légèrement organique, comme si quelque chose était caché en dessous.
De la seconde 0 à la seconde 2, gardez le cadre presque immobile et vide, avec seulement un mouvement ambiant subtil dans la texture et un lent, doux travelling avant de la caméra. L’ambiance doit être calme, introspective et pleine de suspense.
À partir de la seconde 2, le visage de la femme émerge progressivement de l’obscurité, comme s’il se formait depuis l’intérieur même de la surface. D’abord, les yeux deviennent à peine visibles, puis le nez et les lèvres apparaissent doucement, jusqu’à ce que le visage soit suffisamment net pour soutenir un regard direct, calme et pénétrant vers le spectateur. Son apparence doit être surréaliste et élégante, sans brusquerie ni aspect effrayant. Gardez des mouvements extrêmement subtils : un léger clignement des yeux, une respiration discrète et une immobilité délicate du visage.
Au fur et à mesure que le visage devient visible, elle parle lentement et clairement d’une voix féminine douce et réfléchie :
“You do not need more time. You need fewer things pretending to deserve your attention.”
Ses lèvres doivent être synchronisées naturellement avec l’ensemble de la phrase. Son expression doit rester posée, sage et discrètement intense. La réplique doit paraître philosophique, perspicace et pratique.
Après qu’elle a fini de parler, laissez le visage se dissoudre progressivement dans la même surface sombre et texturée, les traits s’effaçant jusqu’à ce qu’il ne reste plus que le fond uni vert émeraude-noir, en écho au début. Le dernier instant doit paraître calme, envoûtant et complet.
Audio : voix féminine douce captée de près, texture respiratoire subtile, ambiance atmosphérique minimale, pas de musique, pas d’effets sonores dramatiques.
Style visuel : réalisme cinématographique surréaliste, minimaliste, photoréaliste, mélancolique, philosophique, tons vert émeraude profond et charbon, léger grain de film, éclairage raffiné, rythme lent et hypnotique.
Direction technique : plan unique en continu, sans coupe, exactement 10 secondes, sans sous-titres, sans texte à l’écran.

ja.content:
参照画像を視覚的なインスピレーションとして、10秒のシネマティックな動画を作成してください。シーンは、画面全体を埋める、無地で暗く、質感のあるエメラルドブラックの表面から始まり、最初は顔は一切見えません。背景は滑らかでミニマル、神秘的で、わずかに有機的な印象で、何かがその下に隠れているように感じられるべきです。  
0秒から2秒までは、フレームをほぼ静止した空の状態に保ち、テクスチャの中にごくわずかな環境的な動きと、ゆっくり穏やかなカメラの前進のみを加えてください。ムードは静かで内省的、そしてサスペンスを感じさせるものにしてください。  
2秒以降、女性の顔が暗闇の中から徐々に現れ、まるで表面そのものの内側から形作られていくように見せてください。まず目がかすかに見え始め、次に鼻と唇がやわらかく現れ、やがて視聴者をまっすぐに、落ち着いて、鋭く見つめ返せるほど顔がはっきりします。彼女の見た目は、突然でも怖くもなく、非現実的でエレガントに感じられるべきです。動きは極めて控えめに保ち、やわらかなまばたき1回、わずかな呼吸、繊細な表情の静止だけにしてください。  
顔が見えるようになると、彼女は柔らかく内省的な女性の声で、ゆっくり、はっきりと話します。  
“You do not need more time. You need fewer things pretending to deserve your attention.”  
唇の動きは、この全文と自然に同期していなければなりません。表情は終始、落ち着きがあり、賢く、静かな強さを保ってください。この一文は、哲学的で、洞察に富み、実用的に感じられるべきです。  
話し終えたら、顔が再び同じ暗い質感の表面へと徐々に溶け込むように消え、輪郭が薄れて、最終的には無地のエメラルドブラックの背景だけが残るようにしてください。これは冒頭を呼び戻すような演出です。最後の瞬間は、静かで、忘れがたく、完結した印象にしてください。  
Audio: ソフトな近接マイクの女性ボイス、わずかな呼吸の質感、最小限の環境音、音楽なし、派手な効果音なし。  
Visual style: surreal cinematic realism, minimalist, photorealistic, moody, philosophical, deep emerald and charcoal tones, soft film grain, refined lighting, slow hypnotic pacing.  
Technical direction: single continuous shot, no cuts, exactly 10 seconds, no subtitles, no on-screen text.

ko.content:
참조 이미지를 시각적 영감으로 삼아 10초짜리 cinematic video를 만들어라. 장면은 평범하고 어둡고 질감이 있는 에메랄드-블랙 표면이 화면 전체를 채운 상태로 시작해야 하며, 처음에는 얼굴이 전혀 보이지 않아야 한다. 배경은 매끄럽고 미니멀하며 신비롭고, 마치 그 아래에 무언가 숨겨져 있는 듯 약간 유기적인 느낌이어야 한다.
0초부터 2초까지는 프레임을 거의 정지된 채 비워 두고, 질감 속의 미세한 ambient motion과 함께 느리고 부드러운 camera push forward만 유지한다. 분위기는 조용하고, 내성적이며, 긴장감 있어야 한다.
2초 이후부터는 여성의 얼굴이 어둠 속에서 서서히 떠오르듯, 마치 표면 내부에서 형성되는 것처럼 나타난다. 먼저 눈이 희미하게 보이고, 그다음 코와 입술이 부드럽게 드러나며, 결국 얼굴이 시청자를 향해 직접적이고 차분하며 꿰뚫는 시선을 보낼 수 있을 정도로 선명해진다. 그녀의 모습은 갑작스럽거나 무섭지 않고, 초현실적이면서도 우아하게 느껴져야 한다. 움직임은 극도로 미세하게 유지한다: 부드러운 한 번의 blink, 약한 숨결, 섬세한 얼굴의 정지감.
얼굴이 보이기 시작하면, 그녀는 부드럽고 사색적인 여성의 목소리로 천천히 또렷하게 말한다:
“You do not need more time. You need fewer things pretending to deserve your attention.”
입술은 전체 문장과 자연스럽게 sync되어야 한다. 표정은 침착하고, 지혜로우며, 조용히 강렬해야 한다. 이 대사는 철학적이고, 통찰력 있으며, 실용적으로 느껴져야 한다.
말을 마친 뒤에는 얼굴이 다시 같은 어둡고 질감 있는 표면 속으로 서서히 녹아들듯 사라지게 하고, 시작할 때와 같은 평범한 에메랄드-블랙 배경만 남도록 한다. 마지막 순간은 차분하고, haunting하며, 완결된 느낌이어야 한다.
Audio: 부드러운 close-mic 여성 목소리, 미세한 호흡 질감, 최소한의 atmospheric ambience, 음악 없음, 극적인 sound effects 없음.
Visual style: 초현실적 cinematic realism, minimalist, photorealistic, moody, 철학적, 짙은 에메랄드와 차콜 톤, 부드러운 film grain, 정제된 lighting, 느리고 최면적인 pacing.
Technical direction: single continuous shot, no cuts, exactly 10 seconds, no subtitles, no on-screen text.

pt.content:
Crie um vídeo cinematográfico de 10 segundos usando a imagem de referência como inspiração visual. A cena deve começar com uma superfície lisa, escura, texturizada, em verde-esmeralda quase preto, ocupando todo o quadro, sem nenhum rosto visível no início. O fundo deve parecer suave, minimalista, misterioso e levemente orgânico, como se algo estivesse escondido sob ele.
Do segundo 0 ao segundo 2, mantenha o quadro quase imóvel e vazio, com apenas um movimento ambiente sutil na textura e um lento e suave avanço da câmera. O clima deve ser silencioso, introspectivo e cheio de suspense.
A partir do segundo 2, o rosto da mulher emerge gradualmente da escuridão, como se estivesse se formando a partir da própria superfície. Primeiro, os olhos ficam levemente visíveis; depois, o nariz e os lábios aparecem suavemente, até que o rosto fique claro o suficiente para sustentar um olhar direto, calmo e penetrante para o espectador. 创建一个 10 秒的 cinematic 视频，以参考图像作为视觉灵感。画面应以一块朴素、深色、带纹理的祖母绿黑色表面开始，铺满整个画面，起初看不到任何脸部。背景应呈现平滑、极简、神秘且略带有机感的氛围，仿佛其下隐藏着某种东西。
从第 0 秒到第 2 秒，画面几乎保持静止且空旷，只在纹理中有极其细微的环境运动，并伴随缓慢、轻柔的镜头向前推进。整体氛围应安静、内省且充满悬念。
从第 2 秒开始，女性的脸 धीरे渐从黑暗中浮现，仿佛正从表面内部生成。先是眼睛隐约可见，然后鼻子和嘴唇柔和显现，直到面部清晰到足以以直接、平静而具有穿透力的目光注视观众。她的出现应显得超现实而优雅，而非突兀或恐怖。动作要极其克制：一次轻柔眨眼、轻微呼吸，以及细腻的面部静止感。
当脸部逐渐清晰时，她用柔和、沉思的女性声音缓慢而清晰地说道：
“You do not need more time. You need fewer things pretending to deserve your attention.”
她的嘴唇必须与整句台词自然同步。她的表情应保持沉稳、睿智且安静而强烈。这句话应带有哲思、洞见与实用性。
在她说完之后，让这张脸逐渐溶解回同样的深色纹理表面，五官慢慢消失，直到只剩下最初那种朴素的祖母绿黑色背景，呼应开头。最后一刻应给人平静、阴森而完整的感觉。
Audio: 柔和的近距离收音女性声音，细微的呼吸质感，极简的环境氛围音，无音乐，无戏剧性音效。
Visual style: surreal cinematic realism, minimalist, photorealistic, moody, philosophical, deep emerald and charcoal tones, soft film grain, refined lighting, slow hypnotic pacing.
Technical direction: single continuous shot, no cuts, exactly 10 seconds, no subtitles, no on-screen text.

The scene should begin with a plain, dark, textured emerald-black surface filling the entire frame, with no visible face at first. The background should feel smooth, minimal, mysterious, and slightly organic, as if something is hidden beneath it.
From second 0 to second 2, keep the frame nearly still and empty, with only subtle ambient motion in the texture and a slow, gentle camera push forward. The mood should feel quiet, introspective, and suspenseful.
From second 2 onward, the woman’s face gradually emerges out of the darkness, as if forming from within the surface itself. First the eyes become faintly visible, then the nose and lips softly appear, until the face becomes clear enough to hold a direct, calm, penetrating gaze toward the viewer. Her appearance should feel surreal and elegant, not abrupt or scary. Keep the movements extremely subtle: one soft blink, slight breath, and delicate facial stillness.
As the face becomes visible, she speaks slowly and clearly in a soft, reflective female voice:
“You do not need more time. You need fewer things pretending to deserve your attention.”
Her lips must synchronize naturally with the full sentence. Her expression should remain composed, wise, and quietly intense. The line should feel philosophical, insightful, and practical.
After she finishes speaking, let the face gradually dissolve back into the same dark textured surface, with the features fading away until only the plain emerald-black background remains, echoing the beginning. The final moment should feel calm, haunting, and complete.
